Inspect sketches, plan_sketch_edit using the operation below; review must be read-only.
apply_sketch_edit with the same intent and current opaque history; native verification is required.

Undo the extrusion first; the next single Undo/Redo removes/restores both the ordinary centre point and ellipse.
